# Faviens

> Agentic-AI consulting based in Zürich, Switzerland. The full site is in
> preparation; this domain currently serves a placeholder page.

## The name

The name blends two Latin words: favere, to act in someone's favour, and
agens, agent. It is a coinage, not a Latin word in its own right.

## Pronunciation

- English: FAY-vee-enz, /ˈfeɪviənz/
- German: FAH-vee-ens, /ˈfɑːviˌɛns/

## Languages

- [Deutsch](https://faviens.com/)
- [English](https://faviens.com/en)
